errors.what: Wheel angle is not continuous or monotonic: it rests at 144 deg, drops to 138.9 at t=5.50s, then jumps to 180 at t=0 and returns to 149.1/144 afterwards. The wheel index goes in the wrong direction (decreasing 180->144 while the driver turns CCW); an external Geneva wheel turns the same sense as the driver (180->216). The wheel also moves backwards before engagement and shows a phase discontinuity at the t=0 wrap.
